welcome.text: Welcome, {name}! 🔥 You're in the Family Trading Competition. Everyone starts with $10,000 in virtual cash and the best portfolio wins. What do you want to do? 👇

how_it_works.text: How it works 1. You get $10,000 virtual cash 2. Buy and sell coins at live prices 3. Your total value = cash + coins 4. When the competition ends, the highest total wins 🏆 Ready to start?

markets.text: Markets 📈 Pick a coin to see what it is and trade it. (Edit this step in the admin page to add your real coins.)

coin_btc.text: Bitcoin (BTC) The biggest and oldest cryptocurrency. Usually moves slower than smaller coins.

coin_eth.text: Ethereum (ETH) The second biggest coin. Powers a huge ecosystem of apps.

buy_soon.text: Trading goes live when the competition starts. Stay tuned! ⏳

leaderboard.text: Leaderboard 🏆 No trades yet. The ranking will show here once the competition begins.

rules.text: Rules ❓ • Virtual money only • Same $10,000 start for everyone • No changing someone else's account • Winner is decided by total portfolio value at the end
